correctness.rationale: For n>=2, a vertex of Hamming radius w>=1 first becomes reachable in exactly w steps. Each shortest direction word is a permutation of w distinct flipped coordinates. Uniform coin is a +1 Grover eigenvector, so first-step amplitude 1/sqrt(n) and each subsequent distinct-direction transition amplitude 2/n; (w-1)! same-sign words end in each of w orthogonal coin channels. Squaring gives Pq=w!(w-1)!4^{w-1}/n^{2w-1}; classic Pcl=w!/n^w; ratio=4^{w-1}(w-1)!/n^{w-1}. Stirling for w/n->rho>0 yields exponent rho log(4rho/e), exact sign crossover e/4. At w=n the antipodal asymptotic follows from two-term Stirling. Independent full coined-walk unitary evolution for every w in n=2..6 matched the exact first-arrival probability. This does not infer the all-n theorem from finite evolution tests.
